{{incomplete|article|Personality and characteristics section; manga info (if they appeared)}} [[File:Legendary titans M08.png|thumb|300px|The three legendary giants]] The '''legendary giants''' are a trio of [[Legendary Pokémon]] that appeared in ''[[M08|Lucario and the Mystery of Mew]]''. They guard the [[Tree of Beginning]] from intruders. ==In the movies== ===Regirock=== {{AnimePokémonInfobox| type1=rock| type2=| ball=None| nickname=Regirock| jnickname=レジロック| tmnickname=Regirock| image=[[File:Regirock M08.png|300px]]| caption=Regirock | caught=no| ability={{a|Clear Body}}{{tt|*|Games only, via event distribution}}| epnum=M08| epname=Lucario and the Mystery of Mew| prevonum=377| noevo=incap | pokemonname=Regirock| current=[[Tree of Beginning]]| java1=[[List of Japanese voice actors|Eiji Miyashita]] | }} '''Regirock''' (Japanese: '''レジロック''' ''Regirock'') appeared in ''[[M08|Lucario and the Mystery of Mew]]''. ====History==== {{p|Regirock}} was the first to attack {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}}. It met them at the entrance to the [[Tree of Beginning]] and, believing they were there to do harm, attacked them with its {{m|Hyper Beam}}. However, {{mov|Lucario|Lucario|8}} incapacitated it with {{m|Aura Sphere}}, allowing the group to flee into the Tree of Beginning. Regirock later chased [[Jessie]] and [[James]] throughout the caves alongside Registeel; it chased them until they met up with Ash and the others. After a short chase, Lucario had to break a stone bridge to stop Regirock and Registeel from continuing their pursuit. However, they managed to catch up to the gang easily, and continued the chase. Regirock and Registeel eventually ambushed Ash, {{AP|Pikachu}}, Lucario, and [[Kidd Summers]] in one chamber, but as a result of the distraction, Ash and Kidd were absorbed by the Tree of Beginning's immune system. After {{mov|Mew|Mew|8}} revived Ash and his friends from the Tree of Beginning's immune system, Regirock and the others left them alone, no longer believing them to be a threat. ====Moves used==== {{anmov/h|rock||Regirock {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 2}}|0=Dig|1=Hyper Beam}} M08.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 2}}|0=Dig|1=Hyper Beam}}}} {{anmov|ground|Dig|M08|Lucario and the Mystery of Mew}} {{anmov|normal|Hyper Beam|M08|Lucario and the Mystery of Mew}} {{anmov/f|rock|no}} {{-}} ===Registeel=== {{AnimePokémonInfobox| type1=steel| ball=None| nickname=Registeel| jnickname=レジスチル| tmnickname=Registeel| image=[[File:Registeel M08.png|300px]]| caption=Registeel | caught=no| ability={{a|Clear Body}}{{tt|*|Games only, via event distribution}}| epnum=M08| epname=Lucario and the Mystery of Mew| prevonum=379| noevo=incap | pokemonname=Registeel| current=[[Tree of Beginning]]| java1=[[List of Japanese voice actors|Atsushi Kakehashi]] | }} '''Registeel''' (Japanese: '''レジスチル''' ''Registeel'') appeared in ''[[M08|Lucario and the Mystery of Mew]]''. ====History==== {{p|Registeel}} was first seen crushing one of Kidd's spy robots underfoot as it was inspecting one of the Tree of Beginning's crystals. Registeel later chased [[Jessie]] and [[James]] throughout the caves alongside Regirock; it chased them until they met up with Ash and the others. After a short chase, Lucario had to break a stone bridge to stop Registeel and Regirock from continuing their pursuit. However, they managed to catch up to the gang easily, and continued the chase. Registeel and Regirock eventually caught up to Ash, Pikachu, Lucario, and Kidd, with Registeel restraining Lucario. However, this led to the Tree of Beginning's antibodies absorbing Ash and Kidd. After Mew revived Ash and his friends from the Tree of Beginning's immune system, Registeel and the others left them alone, no longer believing them to be a threat. ====Moves used==== {{anmov/h|steel||Registeel {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 2}}|0=Hyper Beam|1=Shock Wave}} M08.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 2}}|0=Hyper Beam|1=Shock Wave}}}} {{anmov|normal|Hyper Beam|M08|Lucario and the Mystery of Mew}} {{anmov|electric|Shock Wave|M08|Lucario and the Mystery of Mew}} {{anmov/f|steel}} {{-}} ===Regice=== {{AnimePokémonInfobox| type1=Ice| ball=None| nickname=Regice| jnickname=レジアイス| tmnickname=Regice| image=[[File:Regice M08.png|300px]]| caption=Regice | caught=no| ability={{a|Clear Body}}{{tt|*|Games only, via event distribution}}| epnum=M08| epname=Lucario and the Mystery of Mew| prevonum=378| noevo=incap | pokemonname=Regice| current=[[Tree of Beginning]]| java1=[[List of Japanese voice actors|Kunihiro Kawamoto]] | }} '''Regice''' (Japanese: '''レジアイス''' ''Regice'') appeared in ''[[M08|Lucario and the Mystery of Mew]]''. ====History==== {{p|Regice}} first attacked {{Ash}} while he was running up a hill to be reunited with Pikachu. Despite Ash trying to reason with it, Regice continued its attack, forcing Lucario to use Aura Sphere to distract it. It later attempted to attack Ash after he rescued Pikachu from being blown away into a chasm. After Mew revived Ash and his friends from the Tree of Beginning's immune system, Regice and the others left them alone, no longer believing them to be a threat. It briefly reappeared in a montage in ''[[M10|The Rise of Darkrai]]'', which chronicled the preceding nine {{pkmn|movie}}s. ====Moves used==== {{anmov/h|ice||Regice {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 2}}|0=Ice Beam M08|1=Hyper Beam M10}}.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 2}}|0=Ice Beam|1=Hyper Beam}}}} {{anmov|ice|Ice Beam|M08|Lucario and the Mystery of Mew}} {{anmov|normal|Hyper Beam|M10|The Rise of Darkrai}} {{anmov/f|ice}} ==In the games== {{main|List of Japanese event Pokémon distributions in Generation III#Hadō Legendary giants|Hadō legendary giants}} Three legendary giants were distributed on September 1 to 25, 2005 for Japanese players of [[Generation III]] handheld {{pkmn|games}}, to commemorate the eighth Pokémon movie. {{G3event| ball=Poké| balllink=Poké Ball (item)| pokemon=Regirock| nick=レジロック| level=40| game=3f| ndex=377| typea=Rock| ot={{color|0070f8|ハドウ}}
